title: Here's How To Switch From ChatGPT To Claude Without Losing Any Information
excerpt: If you want to move from OpenAI's ChatGPT to Anthropic's Claude, the Claude app and web interface make it simple. But you have to know where to look.
content_html:
A little copy/pasting is all it takes.

OpenAI, Anthropic

If you're moving from ChatGPT to Claude, you don't have to start with a clean slate. Earlier this year, Anthropic added Claude's Import Memory feature, which lets you bring over saved context from other chatbots. Here's how to get the best results.

Goodbye, ChatGPT, hello Claude

There are a few reasons you might want to switch from ChatGPT to Claude. Maybe you like Claude's coding abilities, or perhaps you've soured on OpenAI because of its deal with the Department of Defense. If you are making the move, the good news is there isn't much of a learning curve. The main challenge is moving your saved context from one chatbot to the other — and Anthropic's import tool makes that part dead simple.

Note that you don't have to use memory at all. Claude and other AI chatbots are perfectly functional without remembering your preferences or past chats. (In that case, each new thread is a fresh start.) These steps are only for people who want to carry that context over.

How to import memory from ChatGPT to Claude

Screenshot by Will Shanklin (Anthropic)

To get the best results, you'll want to set things up on both sides. These steps work on the web and in the desktop apps for Claude and ChatGPT:

  1. In Claude, click your profile picture on the bottom-left. Then, head to Settings > Memory. If you don't see that entry, look under Settings > Capabilities. (Anthropic is in the process of rolling out an updated interface.) Turn on Generate Memories from chats if it isn't yet activated.
  2. Next to Import memory from other AI providers, click Start Import.
  3. Click Copy next to the prompt Claude provides.
  4. Open ChatGPT. Click your profile picture, open Personalization, and make sure Enable Memory is turned on. (If you're only turning it on now, you'll want to wait a few hours while it updates your memories.)
  5. Optionally, switch the ChatGPT model from Auto to Thinking using the keyboard shortcut Shift-Ctrl-M. Thinking mode allows ChatGPT to pull together a more thorough summary.
  6. Paste Claude's prompt from step 2 into a new chat in ChatGPT and run it. It should generate a block of text summarizing your saved context. Copy the full output.
  7. Back in Claude, paste ChatGPT's output into the import field and click Add to memory.

Of course, this feature isn't limited to ChatGPT. If you're moving from Gemini, the same basic process applies. You just need to turn on its memory feature under Settings > Personal Intelligence > Memory before entering Claude's import prompt and pasting the result back into Claude.

Confirming the import

Screenshot by Will Shanklin (Anthropic)

Anthropic says it can take up to 24 hours for the import to finish. So, don't panic if Claude's answers don't seem to incorporate your old context right away.

After that, you can review what Claude remembers in Settings > Memory (or Settings > Capabilities > Memory from your chats if your account still uses legacy settings).

content_html_zh:
只需要一点点复制/粘贴即可。

OpenAI、人择

如果您要从 ChatGPT 迁移到 Claude，则不必从头开始。 今年早些时候，Anthropic 添加了 Claude 的导入内存功能，该功能可让您从其他聊天机器人中导入保存的上下文。 以下是如何获得最佳结果。

再见，ChatGPT，你好，克劳德

您可能出于多种原因想要从 ChatGPT 切换到 Claude。 也许您喜欢 Claude 的编码能力，或者您可能因为 OpenAI 与国防部的交易而对它感到厌烦。 如果您要采取行动，好消息是没有太多的学习曲线。 主要挑战是将您保存的上下文从一个聊天机器人转移到另一个聊天机器人，而 Anthropic 的导入工具使这部分变得非常简单。

请注意，您根本不必使用内存。 克劳德和其他人工智能聊天机器人功能完美，无需记住您的偏好或过去的聊天记录。 （在这种情况下，每个新线程都是一个新的开始。） 这些步骤仅适用于想要保留该上下文的人。

如何将内存从 ChatGPT 导入到 Claude

威尔·尚克林 (Will Shanklin) 的截图（Anthropic）

为了获得最佳结果，您需要在两侧进行设置。 这些步骤适用于 Claude 和 ChatGPT 的网络和桌面应用程序：

  1. 在 Claude 中，单击左下角的个人资料图片。 然后，前往“设置”>“内存”。 如果您没有看到该条目，请查看“设置”>“功能”。 （Anthropic 正在推出更新的界面。） 如果尚未激活，请启用“从聊天中生成记忆”。
  2. 在从其他 AI 提供商导入内存旁边，单击开始导入。
  3. 单击克劳德提供的提示旁边的复制。
  4. 打开 ChatGPT。 单击您的个人资料图片，打开个性化，并确保启用内存已打开。 （如果你现在才打开它，你需要等待几个小时，它会更新你的记忆。）
  5. 或者，使用键盘快捷键 Shift-Ctrl-M 将 ChatGPT 模型从“自动”切换到“思考”。 思考模式让ChatGPT能够整理出更全面的总结。
  6. 将步骤 2 中的 Claude 提示粘贴到 ChatGPT 中的新聊天中并运行它。 它应该生成一个文本块，总结您保存的上下文。 复制完整输出。
  7. 返回 Claude，将 ChatGPT 的输出粘贴到导入字段中，然后单击“添加到内存”。

当然，这个功能不仅限于ChatGPT。 如果您要离开双子座，则适用相同的基本流程。 您只需在“设置”>“个人智能”>“记忆”下打开其记忆功能，然后进入克劳德的导入提示并将结果粘贴回克劳德即可。

确认导入

威尔·尚克林 (Will Shanklin) 的截图（Anthropic）

Anthropic 表示导入最多可能需要 24 小时才能完成。 因此，如果克劳德的答案似乎没有立即融入您以前的背景，请不要惊慌。

之后，您可以在“设置”>“内存”（如果您的帐户仍使用旧设置，则可以在聊天中的“设置”>“功能”>“内存”）中查看克劳德记住的内容。
